baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَهْلَكْنَا / أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا / فَنَقَّبُوا فِى ٱلْبِلَادِ / هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: A stronger coercive capacity is converted into passage-making and countrywide search, but every route remains inside the field of destruction; force enlarges mobility without producing an exit.

activation_trace.role: Falling into ruin supplies the terminal condition that all movement fails to evade.
Strength and solidity establish unusually high capacity before its failure is tested.
Seizing with force makes that capacity coercive and materially effective.
A penetrating route through hard terrain turns power into passage-making.
Travel and searching across lands turns the passage into an attempted hunt for an outlet.
Bounded tracts of earth provide the many places traversed but never a beyond.
Deviation and flight name the absent lateral outlet that closes the mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Many stronger predecessors were destroyed and found no refuge.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a failed escape experiment: superior force produces routes through whole lands, yet no lateral motion crosses beyond destruction.

baseline_models.mechanism: The destroyed unit is not merely a date but a cohort joined within one time and able to act as a collective rival; its earlier position makes it a tested precedent confronting the present audience.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence places the cohort ahead of the addressees as an already completed trial.
People conjoined in one time supplies the historical cohort rather than an isolated strongman.
Binding one thing to another gives the cohort functional cohesion.
Becoming capable of facing an opponent makes the joined cohort a power-bearing formation.

changed_reading.before: Qarn is only a past generation label.
changed_reading.after: Qarn is a bound, capable social formation whose completed history is placed before the audience as evidence that collective capacity gives no immunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context changes land from neutral escape-space into a medium that receives bodily loss without erasing it, is revived after death, and produces emergence. The traversed land therefore holds and releases people; it does not hide them.

activation_trace.role: Searching across countries treats terrain as a prospective escape medium.
The bounded earthly places are the material field whose function context revises.
The missing deviation marks the self-directed exit that terrain cannot supply.
The lower earth receives what is diminished from bodies, making disappearance spatially internal rather than beyond reach.
Guarding and preserving blocks earthly diminution from becoming erasure.
Rain-life revives earth and supplies the restorative operation.
The same bounded-land image becomes a dead and then reactivated substrate.
Loss of life marks the land-state that revival reverses.
Passage to the outside supplies a real emergence, but one generated from the land rather than found by fugitives.

structural_cues: 50:4 pairs what earth diminishes with preserved knowledge; 50:11 pairs a revived dead balda with the explicit analogy 'thus the emergence'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earthly diminution, preservation, revived land, and emergence; I infer that these functions govern the focus lands as custody and release. A live alternative is that 50:11 is only a resurrection analogy, without making the focus geography custodial.

changed_reading.before: The lands are merely the wide terrain across which fugitives fail to find refuge.
changed_reading.after: The lands are an inescapable medium: they receive without erasing and eventually release the dead, so their only effective exit is resurrection rather than flight.

context_deltas.mechanism: N-Q-B's branch of investigating interiors reverses direction. Those who search the external lands are themselves exhaustively penetrated: inner whisper is known, utterance is guarded, habitual deviation is named, and the cover is removed.

activation_trace.role: Searching hidden interiors and reports turns the travelers into investigators whose direction can be reversed.
Attempted deviation supplies what total knowledge and disclosure prevent.
Disclosure to the knower establishes access deeper than geographic reconnaissance.
Hidden self-talk supplies the innermost layer already reached.
Speech brought out by the tongue moves the trace from interior thought to exterior evidence.
Guarding and preservation prevent emitted speech from escaping the evidentiary field.
Turning aside from the path is the context's enacted near-image of the focus's absent maḥīṣ.
Removing a cover completes the reversal by exposing the formerly concealed subject.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from hidden whisper, to emitted and guarded speech, to attempted turning aside, to a removed covering and sharpened sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested concealment, surveillance, deviation, and disclosure; I apply N-Q-B's interior-search image reflexively to the searcher. The live alternative is the nearer branch B006, in which N-Q-B remains ordinary travel with no investigative reversal.

changed_reading.before: They conduct an outward search through lands for a route away.
changed_reading.after: Their outward reconnaissance is ironic: while they probe the landscape, their own interior, speech, evasions, and coverings are more completely probed and exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated SH-D-D image migrates from the predecessors' comparative strength to the severity of punishment. Their violent grasp is not met merely by a stronger rival agent; it is enclosed within a condition now bearing the strength predicate.

activation_trace.role: Strength and solidity first belong comparatively to the destroyed cohort.
Forceful seizure specifies how their strength operates.
Painful punishment supplies the encompassing condition into which the strength image moves.
The same force-and-severity branch now qualifies punishment rather than human capacity.

structural_cues: The exact SH-D-D root recurs in 50:26 as the adjective of punishment before it recurs in 50:36 as the comparative strength of destroyed peoples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root repetition and the two different hosts of the adjective; I infer a transfer of the strength frame from actors to consequence. A live alternative is ordinary descriptive repetition with no designed reassignment.

changed_reading.before: The comparison implies only that an even stronger destroyer overcame strong people.
changed_reading.after: Human strength is relativized by being shifted into severe punishment itself: their force becomes something enclosed, not the controlling measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humanly made penetration through lands yields no escape, but the later summons makes the earth itself split and rapidly release people into directed gathering. A breach and an exit do exist; they remove agency rather than restore it.

activation_trace.role: Piercing through to what lies beyond supplies the failed human attempt to manufacture an opening.
The absent escape distinguishes a self-chosen route from the later compelled opening.
The terrifying cry supplies the external summons that initiates emergence.
Movement to the outside supplies the exit that the focus question had denied as refuge.
The earth's splitting open creates the real breach that human tunneling could not turn into escape.
The lower earth itself becomes the opening medium rather than a terrain crossed at will.
Driving and collecting a group toward one destination fixes the direction of the exit.
Ease after difficulty makes this compelled opening effortless for its agent, unlike the failed human search.

structural_cues: 50:41-44 forms a causal sequence: nearby call, heard cry, emergence, splitting earth, and rapid gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the summons-to-splitting-to-gathering sequence; I contrast it with the focus's penetration and no-escape question. A live alternative is that the two openings are separate eschatological and historical images without a deliberate agency reversal.

changed_reading.before: No opening or exit can be found anywhere in the land.
changed_reading.after: An opening and exit are finally supplied, but as involuntary exposure and transport into gathering; the only successful breach is the opposite of escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's violent grasp diagnoses a failed power regime, while the closing instruction bars coercive control and assigns recitation and reminder to the hearer responsive to warning. The warning's content is force; its communicative method is not.

activation_trace.role: Seizure by force supplies the doomed mode of human power that must not govern the address.
Coercive compulsion names the role explicitly denied to the messenger.
A reminder that makes one remember replaces seizure as the operative intervention.
Recitation supplies the noncoercive medium of that reminder.
Anticipatory fear identifies the hearer's inward responsiveness rather than imposed compliance.
Threatening warning carries the consequence recalled by the focus destruction scene.

structural_cues: The final ayah joins 'not a compeller over them' directly to 'remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My warning'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forceful grasp, denied compulsion, and commanded reminder; I infer a contrast between the warning's violent history and its delivery. A live alternative is that jabbār means controller rather than coercive enforcer, weakening but not removing the contrast.

changed_reading.before: The destruction of stronger peoples can sound like a threat whose force is to be reproduced in proclamation.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes coercive grasp as doomed while the surah prescribes remembrance and recitation, not grasp, as the way its warning reaches a hearer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the singular companions in 50:23 and 50:27 are not the historical qarn's syntactic referent. It remains valid as an exact Q-R-N root resonance joining cohort, binding, and companion branches; render it only as a secondary social echo, not as a claim that qarn lexically means the judgment companion here.

activation_trace.role: A people conjoined in one time supplies the overt historical generation.
Binding one thing to another exposes attachment inside the generation image.
An attached companion makes the shared root relational and personally accountable.
The companion's disavowal turns attachment into contested responsibility.

changed_reading.before: The destroyed generation is an anonymous slice of historical time.
changed_reading.after: The generation can faintly register as a web of attachments whose companion-relations later reappear as testimony and disavowal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a syntax-level rather than root-level activation: the focus's 'hal min maḥīṣ' echoes 50:30's paired questions about fullness and 'hal min mazīd'. It stays anchored in the focus's no-outlet construction and branch-backed container images; render it as rhetorical topology, not as lexical derivation or a certain cross-reference.

activation_trace.role: Inextricable constriction supplies the closed human outlet in the repeated question form.
Filling to the measure of a container supplies the questioned capacity on the judgment side.
Increase and growth keep that intake rhetorically open when the human exit is closed.

changed_reading.before: The no-refuge question is an isolated closure of the historical example.
changed_reading.after: It can echo a larger asymmetry: no open outlet for the fleeing subject, while judgment's receiving capacity asks for increase.

strongest_changes: Land changes from escape terrain into a preserving, reviving, and finally opening medium whose exit leads to gathering.
N-Q-B's search image reverses onto the searcher as whisper, speech, evasion, and covering become known and exposed.
SH-D-D moves strength from violent cohorts into severe punishment, while the final instruction refuses coercive grasp as the warning's method.
summary.what_was_special: Exact B-L-D, Q-R-N, and SH-D-D recurrences, the near-image H-Y-S/H-Y-D, and the reversal from human tunneling to earth's compelled opening produced several distinct but coexisting mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: N-Q-B B008's interior investigation is branch-backed but more form-distant than the likely travel branch B006.
The Q-R-N companion resonance and repeated hal-min topology are secondary echoes, not syntactic disambiguations.
The B-T-SH/J-B-R contrast depends on reading the final denial of jabbār as a response to the focus's coercive power.
